'''Cosa''' is a male NPC who appears at the bar in [[Montelli Quarter]], [[Ragunna]]. he can be seen talking to [[Rafael]] during the daytime.

==Dialogue==
{{Dialogue Start}}
:'''Cosa:''' Have you heard? Averardo Vault has suddenly tightened its security.
:'''Rafael:''' Probably just a routine security drill.
:'''Rafael:''' After all, it's the safest place in Rinascita. Nothing can go wrong there.
:'''Cosa:''' Let's hope so. As long as nothing happens to my precious Echo in the vault...
:'''Rafael:''' Precious Echo? What Echo is precious enough to be in Averardo Vault?
:'''Cosa:''' Shh, keep it down!
:'''Cosa:''' It's a rare specimen. I paid a fortune to bring it back from Jinzhou, Huanglong.
:'''Cosa:''' It's called Dwarf Cassowary. They say it's particularly clever and understands human language.
:'''Rafael:''' Really? I'd love to see that...
{{Dialogue End}}
